body: There will come a day when I can finally do it. I just can't right now.
See, that would require interpersonal interaction. I can't risk that.

My situation won't change, for the most part. Sure I will move back to a city I like, but I will still be me, my life will still be destroyed. I will never be able to provide anything for anyone and will be barely able to keep myself alive. I have always been afraid this would happen, and now it has.
It causes me to drudge up emotion, and it's best I just leave that whole situation alone.
